detail: AC6 allows repeated type parameters, but only repeated brand parameters are tested. Add a functional case requesting two distinct type values, with HTTP 200 and exact numeric minPrice/maxPrice spanning their seeded union, so accepting only the first or last type would fail.

AC5 says the range stays that of the whole selection when the sort changes. TC-16 uses /?brand=1, but Daybird's page 1 (first 9 by name) already contains its cheapest ($49.99 LumenHead Headlamp) and dearest ($449.99 Blizzard Snowboard) products. The 10th, Wanderer at $109.99, is on page 2. catalog-sort.js only reorders the existing cards on the current page, so the visible set and its min/max never change. The 'Why' claim that the page's own cheapest and dearest change is false. A range derived from the visible page would pass this case. Fix: open / (no filter), choose 'Price: High to Low', and expect the first card to show $249.99, '101 products' and 'Prices $21.99 – $699.00'. Page 1 there spans only $79.99–$249.99, so the check would fail if the range came from the visible cards. Navigation does not work either: its page 1 already spans $59.99–$299.00.

The test asserts the URL contains brand=1 and calls demo.caption(`Now at ${page.url()}`) right after toHaveURL. The page is still loading then (frame 03 shows skeleton cards), and the caption is gone in every later frame (03, 04, 05, 06). No frame shows the brand=1 URL. Show the caption after `expect(countOf(page)).toContainText('10 products')` so it stays into the highlight frame. [raised by opus, sol]

Same as TC-10: the 'Now at' caption runs before the type=7 page has loaded and does not survive. Frames 03, 04, 05 and 06 have no caption, so the asserted type=7 URL is never visible. [raised by opus, sol]

The 'Now at' caption after the Footwear click is lost on navigation. Frames 05, 06, 07 and 08 show the 2 products · Prices $109.99 – $149.99 state but never a URL with brand=1&type=1. [raised by opus, sol]

The 'Now at' caption after the Next page click is lost on navigation. Frames 03, 04, 05, 06 and 07 never show page=2 in a caption. The pager frame (04) proves page 2 is current, but the asserted URL is not shown. [raised by opus, sol]
